name: Onegai♪ Goshujin-sama!
original_name: おねがい♪ご主人さまっ！
source:
Saku has taken over his grandfather's house. It looks old but he likes it. But his grandfather's maid says, "To take over this house, you will need to hire at least five maids." He likes maids but he has no time. He recruits them randomly and hires five maids including a broken maid robot, his childhood friend, a sealed off devil...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
朔继承了祖父的房子。房子虽然老旧，他却很喜欢。然而，祖父的女仆告诉他：“想继承这栋房子，你至少得雇用五名女仆。”他虽喜欢女仆，却没有时间仔细挑选，于是随意招募并雇用了五人，其中包括一台故障女仆机器人、他的青梅竹马，还有一名遭到封印的恶魔……？

[摘自ErogeShop]
